title: Redaction catalogue upgrades: github_pat_, partial-KV leak, FP boundaries
description: Inherited upstream gaps found by np8.6 adversarial review (all verified identical upstream, so not port bugs): (1) bare github_pat_ fine-grained tokens leak entirely (gh[pousr]_ pattern can't match). (2) .env PASSWORD=p@ssw0rd!FAKE partially redacts — value class stops at @, output LOOKS redacted but leaks the tail; dangerous polarity. (3) openai sk- pattern has no left boundary: prose like 'risk-assessment' → 'ri[REDACTED:openai]' mangles CLAUDE.md rendering. (4) /key/i SECRET_KEY filter redacts keybindings.json 'key': 'ctrl+k' entries (3 FP hits in claude-rich fixture). Also consider xoxb- Slack tokens. Each fix is a documented divergence from upstream; keep the divergence header in patterns.ts current. Related: [[np8.10]] URL-embedded creds.
notes: Round-3 review PASS-WITH-NITS. Residual documented: (1) unencoded '/' inside a URL password truncates the url_credentials match (legal-but-rare per RFC 3986, tail leaks) — noted, not fixed; (2) worst-case throughput ~0.33ms/KB linear — fine at current 64KiB-content scale, consider line-chunking if ever rendering 10MB files.
close_reason: github_pat_, widened kv unquoted value, sk-/sk-ant left boundary, exact-key keybinding exemption, slack xox pattern; all documented as divergences with timing guards

title: Scanner: .github/instructions/*.instructions.md not scannable at project scope
description: Follow-up to agentconfig-np8.12. The copilot detector's extract() enriches files with .github/instructions/*.instructions.md (path-scoped Copilot format, present in copilot-basic and used for scopedInstructionsCount extras), but the project-scope include rules never collect those files on real scans: ADDITIONAL_KNOWN_FILES is exact-path only and KNOWN_DIRS has no .github/instructions entry. Not a match trigger, so detection is unaffected — but scopedInstructionsCount is always 0 and instruction content never reaches parsers on real trees. Fix candidates: add '.github/instructions' to KNOWN_DIRS-style additions (documented, like GLOBAL_SKIP_DIRS/ADDITIONAL_KNOWN_FILES precedent) or a suffix rule.
close_reason: Scanner collects .github/instructions/*.instructions.md via documented prefix+suffix predicate (not mutating verbatim tables); over-collection guarded by test (workflows/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/plain-md excluded). 18 scanner tests. P3 cleanup — orchestrator-reviewed inline (small surgical predicate, over-collection test proves the guard).
